create.name: Eoin Finn
create.bio:
Eoin Finn is a Canadian yoga teacher, surfer and ocean campaigner who began practising in 1989 and founded Blissology, his own school and style of yoga, in 1999. He read philosophy at Dalhousie University and later studied exercise physiology and anatomy, and his early grounding in Ashtanga Vinyasa still shows in the flowing sequences he teaches. A knee injury from a forceful adjustment in 2000 set him questioning how alignment was usually taught, work that eventually became his crowdfunded book Blissology: Yoga Optimized and its accompanying online course.

His classes join strong, fluid movement with meditation, yoga philosophy and a recurring theme of quiet time in nature, and lately he has added calisthenics-style strength work and an ocean-inspired movement method he calls Superflow. From his base in Victoria, British Columbia, he runs 200-hour teacher trainings there, in Bali and online, a modular 500-hour track, and yoga and fitness retreats in Bali and Quebec, and he tours studios and festivals across North America. He also hosts an on-demand video library and a podcast. In 2014 he started the EcoKarma project, linking yoga communities with coral reef protection.

books.title: Blissology: Yoga Optimized
books.author: Eoin Finn
books.description: A large illustrated guide to practising postures by feel rather than by shape. Eoin explains his principle of opposing forces in the body, which he calls DUO, alongside yoga philosophy and practical sequences, drawing on more than three decades of teaching.

courses.title: Yoga Optimized: The Course
courses.description: A self-paced online course of 63 videos built on the Yoga Optimized book, with the relevant pages included in each lesson. It teaches how to create stretch and stability from the inside of a pose and suits all levels.

courses.title: Blissology On Demand
courses.description: A streaming library of Eoin's yoga, meditation and movement classes, available on the web and in an app. Members also get invitations to online Blissology events; single classes can be rented without joining.
courses.price: $16 USD per month or $160 USD per year (30-day free trial); $8 USD to rent one class

courses.title: 100 & 200 Hour Blissology Yoga Teacher Training (Online Anytime)
courses.description: Blissology's Yoga Alliance certified foundation training, taken online at your own pace. It covers his approach to adapting postures to each body, sequencing, philosophy and how to teach with confidence.

courses.title: Yogic by Nature Immersion (San Mateo)
courses.description: Four days with Eoin at Nandi Yoga in San Mateo, California, joining yoga, meditation, philosophy and time outdoors. Part of the 500-hour track but open to anyone curious about yoga philosophy, in person or online.

courses.title: Loose, Fit & Happy: 6-Day Retreat (Bali)
courses.description: A residential week in Bali combining Blissology yoga, strength training, Superflow movement and afternoon philosophy circles. Sessions are planned to build on one another across each day.
courses.price: From $3,750 USD (shared room) to $7,600 USD; early-bird discounts until 30 Nov 2026

free_resources.title: Yoga Optimized: Start Free
free_resources.description: Four free sample videos from the Yoga Optimized course, introducing the DUO principle with a short guided flow to feel it in practice.

flags: Commune class 'Introduction to Blissology' is inside the Commune membership only; no own course page found in Commune's course list or sitemap, so no Commune offering is listed.
All his social accounts are under the Blissology name, but Blissology is his own one-person teaching brand ('Blissology by Eoin Finn'), so they are counted as his.
Email info@blissology.com is the Blissology general inbox (brand inbox).
His Yoga Optimized page says he has taught 'more than 300,000 students'; the owner could treat this as a published student count and raise him to luminary. Not applied here.
Has a teacher page at Omega (eomega.org/workshops/teachers/eoin-finn) but is not in omega-institute-faculty.json, so Omega is not added to teaches_at.
Only one confirmed photo (his own site's portrait); the Omega headshot is a crop of the same shoot, and the YouTube avatar is the Blissology logo.

Recent work leans towards fitness (calisthenics, strength); the Bali retreat schedule includes science talks naming conditions (menopause, sarcopenia). The retreat is kept with a description that names none: check it suits.
His wife Insiya Rasiwala-Finn is listed as press contact; she does not appear as a co-teacher on the pages read, so this is a single listing.
left_out: Videos 'Inhale Prana, Exhale Trauma' and 'The Art of Longevity: The Most Overlooked Biohack' (also a blog post): condition/longevity framing.
'The 10-Day Lower Back and Hamstring Challenge' and the 500-hour 'Yoga and Mind-Body Medicine' module: health-framed titles.
Calisthenics tutorials (L-sit, planche, push-ups) and short promo clips: fitness rather than teaching, or under ~2 minutes.
Single-evening studio workshops in Austin and Denver (12–15 Nov 2026) and the Wonderfruit festival appearance: one-off events.
Quebec Loose, Fit & Happy retreat: 'coming soon in summer 2027', no dates or prices yet.
Newer book 'Yogic by Nature' is mentioned on event pages but no Amazon listing was found.
Free 'Yoga Honey' sequence download sits behind a form on the teacher-training page with no URL of its own.
